related_resources.reason: Approx. fifty Upemba sites, almost three hundred burials, Kamilambian, Kisalian and Kabambian chronologies, wetlands, fisheries, copper; domestic archaeology weak.
Copperbelt production fourth-seventh centuries, HIH large ingots ninth-fourteenth, later types and shifting distribution; interpretations of political boundaries and currency remain hypotheses.
Sanga sample richer in C4 foods and higher caries, Katoto more C3; isotopes cannot uniquely name specific cereals or whole diet; full specimen-level data not examined.
